blocks.text: For three consecutive years, Sunlife Philippines has been recognized at the Insurance Asia Awards for product innovation, reflecting its continued focus on developing solutions that respond to Filipinos’ evolving financial goals and aspirations. Sun Peso Maximizer received the Insurance Product Innovation of the Year award in 2024, followed by Sun Life Secure Income in 2025 and Sun Life EasyLink Protect in 2026. Beyond the recognition, the strong Client response to these products shows how different solutions can resonate with different financial priorities, from growing and preserving wealth and securing a steady stream of income to getting protection and potential growth in […]...
